exam_scheme.note: AP LAWCET is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam on behalf of APSCHE for admission into 3-year and 5-year LL.B. programmes in Andhra Pradesh universities and affiliated law colleges. Total duration is 90 minutes with 120 multiple choice questions of 1 mark each across three parts. No negative marking. Qualifying mark: 35% (42 out of 120) for General/BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for SC/ST candidates.
